description: Source code for testing utilities and command execution helpers within the Mattermost project, including setup, configuration, and command invocation functions.

classes.name: testHelper
classes.description: Helper struct for testing, encapsulating configuration, temporary directories, and command execution context.

methods.name: SetupWithStoreMock
methods.description: Creates and initializes a testHelper instance with mocked store and test resources.

methods.name: InitBasic
methods.description: Initializes basic test helper setup, proxies to api4.InitBasic.

methods.name: TemporaryDirectory
methods.description: Returns the temporary directory used for testing.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Returns a clone of the current configuration.

methods.name: ConfigPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the configuration file.

methods.name: SetConfig
methods.description: Sets and writes the configuration to the config file, disabling strict password requirements for tests.

methods.name: SetAutoConfig
methods.description: Enables or disables automatic passing of the --config flag.

methods.name: execArgs
methods.description: Prepares command-line arguments for executing the test binary, including coverage profile handling.

methods.name: cmd
methods.description: Creates an *exec.Cmd to run the test binary with specified arguments.

methods.name: CheckCommand
methods.description: Runs a command and returns its output, asserting no errors occurred.

methods.name: RunCommand
methods.description: Runs a command, returning only any error encountered.

methods.name: RunCommandWithOutput
methods.description: Runs a command and returns its output along with any error.
